findings.description: calculateReward divides shares[account] by totalShares before multiplying by totalRewards. Integer division truncates the intermediate result to 0 whenever shares[account] < totalShares (the common case for any holder that is not the single largest one), so almost every account receives zero reward regardless of their actual share.
evidence: function calculateReward(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
findings.recommendation: Multiply before dividing: (shares[account] * totalRewards) / totalShares, using a fixed-point scaling factor if additional precision is needed.

limitations: Off-chain logic, deployment configuration and key management were not assessed.
Operational security, infrastructure and tokenomics outside the analyzed code were not assessed.
Deployed contract state and third-party systems were not assessed.
